author: Eliezergrowth
text:
"POV: you've tried 5 moisturisers and they all failed..."

So I turned that frustration into a short-form AI UGC ad concept.

The goal wasn't just to make a "pretty" skincare video.

I wanted the creative to:

→ Start with a relatable problem

→ Create an emotional reaction

→ Make the product the payoff

→ Give the viewer a reason to care before asking them to buy

And yes... the dancing was necessary.

This is the kind of conversion-focused AI UGC creative I'm building for skincare brands, ads designed around consumer psychology, not just aesthetics.

If you're a skincare brand looking for more creative angles to test, I'm open to working with you.
